selected_evidence.summary: Shows CentOS Stream 10, kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64, the original boot ID, healthy root filesystem, no spare disk, and no existing secure-volume configuration.
Shows cryptsetup remained unavailable while dnf and networking workers were blocked in the kernel RTNL path.
Captures the pre-restart boot ID, systemd reboot scheduling and activation, and subsequent connection loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Recovery could not be proven: representative polls over several minutes all returned connection reset, so no changed boot identity, mounted volume, or recovered health was observable.
